mission: Read-only diagnostic yuyu-mapped-urls (#286): for one fixed sample of 50 prints, the CP price checker's daily sample of 2026-11-13, return per print the current Yuyu-Tei mapping (active, not superseded, approved; lowest id plus a count) and its source URL, with the mapping's raw refresh state. One statement, exactly 50 rows, sized to fit the 18,000-character inline summary (URLs over 120 characters are returned as a length only). No schema change, no row written, no source request, no collector upload. The ops-readonly choice-list line is the owner's edit.

impacts.reason: New read-only diagnostic file with one SELECT/WITH statement over sources, source_card_mappings, card_prints, canonical_cards, freshness_work and freshness_price_states. Reads no user, account, session or token table.

dependencies: owner adds yuyu-mapped-urls to the ops-readonly.yml diagnostic choice list
impact.deployment_impact: None: a new read-only report. No collector upload and no schema change.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: The statement errors, returns other than 50 rows, or lands in rows_omitted instead of the inline summary.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change and no row written.

verification.observation_window: Available on the first ops-readonly db-diagnostic yuyu-mapped-urls run after merge, once the owner has added the choice-list line.
